name: jj-workflow
description: Claude Code plugin for working with jujutsu (jj) instead of git.

plugins.name: jj-workflow
plugins.description: Teaches Claude Code to use jujutsu (jj) instead of git. Blocks git commands in jj repos, maps worktrees to jj workspaces, provides /jj-commit, /jj-sync, /jj-push, /jj-resolve, /jj-absorb and /develop, and includes background jj knowledge.
